app.name: Riptide
popup.status.hint.app_not_running: Start Riptide, or press Open Riptide to ask the host to launch it.
popup.status.hint.host_missing: Install Riptide and turn on browser integration in Settings → Integration.
popup.capture.disabled: Capture is turned off in Options
popup.recent.title: Handed to Riptide
popup.recent.empty: Nothing handed off yet. Downloads that match your rules will show up here.
popup.recent.unavailable: Live state unavailable; showing what was sent.
popup.grant.hint: Firefox needs site access to see downloads and links on every page.
notify.not_running.title: Riptide not running — open it?
notify.host_missing.title: Riptide host not found
notify.host_missing.body: Install Riptide and turn on browser integration (Settings → Integration). {name} was left to the browser.
notify.sent.title: Sent to Riptide
notify.failed.title: Riptide could not take this download
notify.reload.title: Reload the page first
notify.reload.body: Riptide cannot read the links on this page until it is reloaded.
options.title: Riptide options
options.minSize.hint: Smaller downloads stay in the browser. 0 means everything.
options.customExtensions.hint: Comma-separated, for example: bin, bak, sav
options.allowSites.hint: One per line. Leave empty for all sites. A site includes its subdomains.
options.altBypass: Hold Alt while clicking a link to let the browser download it
options.notify: Show a notification when a download is sent to Riptide
video.button.label: Download this video with Riptide
video.drm: This video is protected and cannot be downloaded.
video.empty: Riptide found nothing to download on this page.
video.err.not_running: Riptide is not running. Start it and try again.
video.err.host_missing: Riptide is not installed, or browser integration is off (Settings → Integration).
video.err.unknown: Riptide could not read this page.
options.videoButton: Show a “Download this video” button on video pages
options.videoNeverSites: Sites where the video button is turned off
options.hoverBadge: Show a Riptide badge when hovering a file link
options.about.privacy: This extension collects nothing. It talks only to the Riptide app on this computer.
options.ignoreExtensions.hint: These stay in the browser even when their group above is on. Comma-separated, for example: iso, torrent
options.altBypass.hint: Works for clicks on links. The browser gives extensions no modifier keys for downloads, so the page tells the extension about the Alt-click just before the download starts. It cannot work on pages where the extension is not allowed to run (the browser's own pages, the add-on store).
